privcentral.intro: Here you can see what you've authorized, change your mind and exercise your rights over the data we have.
privcentral.sem_escolha: You haven't yet recorded a choice for version {versao} of the policy. The notice will appear on your next visit.
privcentral.metricas_desc: Understand how the platform is used, in aggregate.
privcentral.revogar_nota: Revoking is as simple as authorizing, as required by article 8, §5 of the LGPD. None of this affects your ability to book or pay.
privcentral.seus_dados_texto: Download everything we have about you in a JSON file: profile, bookings, payments, consents and access logs.
privcentral.seus_dados_nota: Immediate handling of access and portability rights (art. 18, II and V). Credentials aren't included: password hashes and tokens aren't exportable personal data, and displaying them would create risk.
privcentral.solicitacoes_texto: Correction, deletion and anonymization require review — deleting an account with a completed payment runs into the tax record-keeping obligation. That's why the request is logged and answered within 15 days.
privcentral.detalhes_placeholder: Describe what you need. E.g.: fix my name from X to Y.
privcentral.historico_texto: A record of each of your decisions. It's what proves, for you and for us, what text you consented to and when.
privcentral.ip_nota: Each record's IP is stored truncated (without the last octet) — enough as proof, without identifying the exact device. This is the minimization principle, art. 6, III.
